programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Spicy kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a tour of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. In the kitchen, they bear witness to our relationship with others, reflecting our vision of the world. Julie's journey will introduce us to the famous black pepper, thanks to Erwann de Kerros, an insatiable pepper seeker. Aromatic plants will also be in the spotlight, as we pick them with Edouard Loubet in the Luberon...

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The wine route
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards. Our trip starts with a bit of tourism. We will cross the Drôme with Tain l'Hermitage and its Baume de Venise, but also the Bordeaux region where the different domains compete to attract this new clientele. Then we head for Épernay, capital of the Champagne region, where the reputation of its sparkling wine is well established.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The chestnut route
programme.desc: Julie takes to the road in her little red car to honour one of her favourite fruits: the chestnut. Julie will meet several producers in Ardèche, cook the traditional soup of the region with the sparkling Marithé. She will also make the recipe for homemade marrons glacés, before heading to Corsica to work with chestnut flour and the leaves of her tree. This journey will end as always with a clever chef's recipe, and this time it will be Claude Brioude who will do it!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Seashells on the menu
programme.desc: We will start this journey near La Rochelle to learn a little more about the breeding of the famous bouchot mussels but also a very particular technique to cook them. We will then go on a tour of France's best oysters: towards Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier and finally Oléron to learn about the different breeding methods and to find out more about all the species in France.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Poultry on the menu
programme.desc: Julie heads for Burgundy to discover ancient breeds of poultry reintroduced to France thanks to the work of breeder Fred Ménager. We'll then move on to Auvergne to discover how the famous Label Rouge is awarded and the role of certifying bodies ... because it's important to know what ends up on our plates. Julie also travels to the Drôme to cook guinea fowl, before heading to the Périgord to prepare a turkey stew.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The flavors of flowers
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The Auxerre country
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The country of Fontainebleau
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Cupboard cooking - Stop wasting food
programme.desc: Leftovers often end up in the garbage can. But with a little thought, it's easy to recycle them. This ecological and economical gesture can even delight our taste buds. Like us, Luana Belmondo hates throwing things away. She knows all about waste-free cooking and has mastered the art. She shows us how to reinvent boiled or steamed potatoes as something other than mashed potatoes. On the program: potato soufflé with paprika and vegetable gratin with curry.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Healthy breakfast
programme.desc: A good breakfast is a healthy, balanced meal made up of 5 energy-giving elements: protein, fiber, carbohydrates, healthy fats and hydration. Luana Belmondo offers us a healthy breakfast that will satisfy both salty and sweet palates: oatmeal, avocado and salmon, buddha bowl with chia seeds and seasonal fruit, and vegan pancakes.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Haut-Rhin
programme.desc: The Haut-Rhin is the epitome of Alsatian charm. Riquewihr and its grands crus, Eguisheim and its half-timbered houses, Colmar and its Little Venice reveal a region where architecture, gastronomy and vineyards come together to offer an unforgettable journey.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Le Quercy
programme.desc: The Quercy region reveals architectural gems and enchanting landscapes. Rocamadour, a town clinging to its cliffs, Saint-Cirq-Lapopie, a picture-postcard village, and Castelnau-Bretenoux, a fairy-tale fortress, illustrate the richness of a land where tradition and history come together in perfect harmony.

programme.desc: Strengthen and detoxify with this powerful and challenging sequence. Twist to Reveal is a process of exploring the gift of presence in order to find what gifts the body can reveal. Be with your breath and let the process unfold.

programme.title: Home training - cardio & training full body 2
programme.desc: This episode of "Home Training" is dedicated to an intense and motivating cardio session. Guillaume and Sabrina start with a full warm-up, emphasizing the importance of preparing the body for an energetic workout. The program includes two standing movement exercises, followed by two on the floor, each performed in four sets of 40 seconds. The goal is to raise the heart rate and strengthen the muscles by alternating between intense efforts and floor exercises.

programme.title: Pilates - Stay in shape with our pilates courses !
Namaste Yoga - Warrior Wisdom: Hip Opening Sequence
programme.desc: With an intense focus on the breath, Warrior Wisdom creates a moment of presence that is attentive, aware and complete. Moving slowly with the breath allows a deeper connection of mind and body that will leave you with greater confidence and strength.

programme.title: Deco Masters - Week 10 - Day 01
programme.desc: A new week of competition begins. Anthony, Vanessa, Samia and Grégory meet in the workshop. The first contender for the title of Ace of Decoration is 35-year-old Anthony. A photographer and blogger from Lille, he fell into the magic potion of decorating at an early age, as his parents ran a decorating boutique. Since then, it's become a real passion!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - winter vegetables
programme.desc: Summer is the season when vegetables abound in the garden, but it would be a shame not to savor those that the cooler seasons have to offer: soups, pies, stews or gratins highlight seasonal vegetables, perfect for a nice warm up. To begin this new journey, Julie will cook salsify. This little tour of France will also allow us to meet gardening goldsmiths who sculpt winter vegetables and fruits.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Truffle flavors
programme.desc: It is a mushroom that we are going to focus on today. A mushroom, or a black diamond, some would say: the truffle. And along the way, we will twist the neck of some clichés. Truffle hunting with dogs, with a sow but also flies... markets and of course cooking to discover or rediscover this mysterious mushroom, in all its aspects, in a salty but also sweet version... Richerenches, Carpentras, Saint Avère, Toulouse, Aix en Provence… the south of France will honor this black diamond!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Shellfish on the menu
programme.desc: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The taste of honey
programme.desc: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been known and consumed as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir, rosemary, orange, spruce, oak, linden or lavender... We'll cross forests, fields and even towns, as bees also forage in urbanized areas. We'll then cook up emblematic recipes like Vercel gingerbread. Finally, we'll discover the European dark bee.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Fish on the menu
programme.desc: Julie takes us to the southern Brittany and more precisely the maritime district of Guilvinec to follow the fish route from the nets to your plate. Le Guilvinec may be the first French artisanal fishing port, but all the seashores of France have good seasonal products. Julie drives up to the south to discover several farmed fish in an aquaculture farm in the Mediterranean, while cooking sea bass in Noirmoutier, monkfish in the north and even cod in the huge market at Rungis.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Cupboard cooking - Improvised aperitive
programme.desc: Impromptu aperitifs aren't always easy. When friends turn up unannounced, stress can quickly mount. Don't panic, Luana Belmondo and Thomas Clouet, a great specialist in the field, improvise an aperitif at the drop of a hat, using very little. Mushroom macaroons, a mini beef tartare and you're ready to go!

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - My wellness dishes
programme.desc: Wellness cuisine is not synonymous with sadness and insipidity. It can be extremely gourmet, for a balanced way to indulge yourself. On this theme, Luana welcomes young wellness pastry chef Johanna Le Pape. Together, they will prepare recipes that are both tasty and perfectly balanced: corn pizza with vegetables and peach-cassis and verbena puffs...

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Le Quercy
programme.desc: The Quercy region reveals architectural gems and enchanting landscapes. Rocamadour, a town clinging to its cliffs, Saint-Cirq-Lapopie, a picture-postcard village, and Castelnau-Bretenoux, a fairy-tale fortress, illustrate the richness of a land where tradition and history come together in perfect harmony.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Haut-Rhin
programme.desc: The Haut-Rhin is the epitome of Alsatian charm. Riquewihr and its grands crus, Eguisheim and its half-timbered houses, Colmar and its Little Venice reveal a region where architecture, gastronomy and vineyards come together to offer an unforgettable journey.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Charente Maritime
programme.desc: Charente-Maritime is a 500-kilometer coastline that conceals an unsuspected heritage. From La Rochelle and its fortified port to the Ile de Ré and its salt marshes, to Talmont-sur-Gironde, a medieval village perched on the estuary, this region reveals itself through the tides and encounters. An immersion between maritime traditions and historical relics.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The Land of the Impressionists
programme.desc: It is in Giverny that Julie's journey begins, the place whose name resounds as the cradle of Impressionism has kept a moving authenticity. Its fame is strongly linked to the historical presence of Claude Monet and to all the fabulous witnesses left by him. Claude Monet also left his mark on the cooking in Giverny. His recipe books are there to testify to this.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Lille country
programme.desc: Head north to discover a French city that cannot be ignored: Lille. The city has an exceptional architectural heritage, a merchant town since the Middle Ages, a citadel under Louis XIV, an industrial town in the 19th century... it expanded over the centuries.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Pasta party
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her Italian friend Alessandra Pierini are preparing a pasta party. They'll be cooking pesto and sharing their tips on how to get it right. They'll also be making pasta saporita, full of color and flavor!

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Desserts from my childhood
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her pastry chef friend Laurent Favre-Mot prepare desserts from our childhood. On the program: panettone in French toast, and torta della nonna with lemon cream and pine nuts, a typical Italian dessert!

programme.title: Ways to School - Youssef, West Bank
programme.desc: Youssef is 11 and lives in the Jordan Valley in the West Bank. He is a "desert dweller", a Bedouin, born during the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Every morning, alone with his donkey, he undertakes a dangerous journey across the arid rocks, near the military patrols to go to school.

programme.title: Ways to School - Devi, India
programme.desc: Devi is 13 and lives in India in an isolated village on the shores of the Sea of Bengal, a country where only boys represent a hope for their parents. Over an hour of walk separates her from her school, through rice fields, forests and muddy water.

programme.title: Ways to School - Olivier Marie and Véronique, Mali
programme.desc: Olivier is 9 and he has got two sisters, Marie and Véronique. He lives in Senou, Mali, near Bamako. Although the front is hundreds of miles away, the war has hardened their conditions of life. With two old bikes for three of them, every morning Oliver and his sisters are trying to reach their school through the muddy tracks.

programme.title: Ways to School - Kritika, Nepal
programme.desc: Kritika is 11 and lives in the rugged mountains of the Himalayas in Nepal, along with her mother and her grandparents. Her father went to work in Dubai. Every morning, leading a group of schoolchildren from the village, she crosses steep paths, frail bridges and waterfalls to reach her school.

programme.title: Ways to School - Jose Alfredo and Angel, Mexico
programme.desc: Jose Alfredo, 12, has been blind from birth. But that doesn't stop him from living in one of the world's biggest cities: Mexico City. The dangers of moving around in such a metropolis are exacerbated for a blind person. Despite this, Jose Alfredo embarks on a 2-hour journey every day, relying solely on his intuition, his cane, and the help of his little brother.

programme.title: Ways to School - Obdulia, Mexico
programme.desc: Obdulia González Fierro is 9 years old, she lives with her parents and brothers in the imposing and desolate Sierra Tarahumara. To get to the religious boarding school in which she receives a formal education, Obdulia and her friend Irma have to travel 6 hours. They walk for 3 hours and spend 3 more on a truck. Along the way they encounter dangers like poisonous snakes and unstable trails in mountains that are over 2,000 meters high.

programme.title: Deco Masters - Week 10 - Day 02
programme.desc: Today, it's the bubbly Vanessa who's going to roll up her sleeves. This 48-year-old Parisian is a tireless artist. Collages or paintings, everything is a pretext for giving free rein to her overflowing imagination.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The flavors of chocolate
programme.desc: Today, the gluttons should not be disappointed since chocolate is in the spotlight. Discovered by the Mayans 2500 years ago and then more widely by the Aztecs, chocolate is today one of the favorite products in the world. And make no mistake about it: just as the kitchen has its great chefs, chocolate also has its great chocolatiers.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Lamb flavors
programme.desc: Tender and tasty, lamb plays a key role in festive cuisine but also in everyday cuisine. Julie sets off on the French roads to discover the different breeds existing across the country. It must be said that France has one of the most varied productions in the world. There are more than forty breeds listed in 5 categories. But more than the breed, it is the way in which they are fed that interests connoisseurs. Julie introduces us to producers and cooks of this refined dish!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Fruits flavors
programme.desc: Every year, the return of summer is a special moment, heralding the arrival of all those beautiful fruits on the shelves. Whether red, exotic or forgotten, fruit is an essential part of our diet. Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll head to Céret, the cherry capital, and then cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The Auxerre country
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The flavors of olive oil
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive. On the way, we will stop at the Sourdon family's house to cook sea bream accompanied by an olive fricot. We will then go to Aix en Provence to prepare a strange dessert: the Fernand-style oil pump.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Cupboard cooking - Stop wasting food

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Pays D'Auge-Calvados
programme.desc: The Pays d'Auge is the beating heart of Normandy. Honfleur with its picturesque port, the Basilica of Lisieux, a major pilgrimage site, and the Haras du Pin, the cradle of horse breeding, illustrate the diversity of this land of traditions, where craftsmanship and gastronomy reign supreme.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Cornouaille
programme.desc: At the western tip of Finistère, Cornouaille embodies the very soul of Brittany. Concarneau and its centuries-old ramparts, Locronan and its cobbled streets, Le Guilvinec and its bustling fleet of trawlers reveal a Brittany that is both historic and vibrant. Between land and sea, this is a land shaped by sailors and legends.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Jura
programme.desc: The Jura reveals itself between high plateaus and forested mountains. From Baume-les-Messieurs, a gem nestled in a natural amphitheater, to Dole, birthplace of Pasteur, to the fortress of Joux, witness to great military times, this journey explores a preserved region where nature and history intertwine harmoniously.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The Country of Le Mans
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The Bordeaux country
programme.desc: Julie meets us in Bordeaux after having surveyed the Blaye region, visited the Basin twice and travelled through the Libourne region twice, it was necessary to stop in the capital of Bordeaux one day! What better time than September to discover the pearl of Aquitaine, more often called the "City of Wine"? Julie invites the inhabitants to discover the traditions but also the more recent projects of this city full of history and gastronomy.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Fajitas
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Mexico with fajitas! A typical Tex-Mex dish. Together, we'll prepare tortillas (corn cakes). Next up, fajitas with chicken, peppers and spices.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - All vegetarian
programme.desc: Luana cooks with the interpreter of the flagship title of Frozen: Anaïs Delva. Together, they will prepare two 100% vegetarian recipes, a philosophy adopted by the singer. On the menu: grilled zucchini fettucini, white beans with pesto and a vegetarian burger. Proof that it's possible to enjoy vegetarian dishes without going hungry!

programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a tour of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. In the kitchen, they bear witness to our relationship with others, reflecting our vision of the world. Julie's journey will introduce us to the famous black pepper, thanks to Erwann de Kerros, an insatiable pepper seeker. Aromatic plants will also be in the spotlight, as we pick them with Edouard Loubet in the Luberon...

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The cheese menu
programme.desc: Today, Julie sets on the roads of France to talk about an essential product on French tables: cheese. With nearly 1,000 varieties (soft cheeses, cooked, blue-veined, pressed cheeses…), the French are the biggest consumers of cheese in the world!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Citrus flavors
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! programme.title: 100 Places to See - Corsica, Balagne
programme.desc: In north-west Corsica, Balagne, nicknamed “the garden of the island”, combines heritage and breathtaking scenery. From Saint-Florent, , a charming Mediterranean port, to the mysterious citadel of Calvi, and through Pigna, a hilltop village with an artistic soul, each stop reveals an authentic Corsica. This journey through unspoilt nature is shared with islanders proud of their land and traditions.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Bay of the Somme
programme.desc: The Baie de Somme boasts an exceptional natural and historical heritage. From the emblematic medieval town of Saint-Valery-sur-Somme to the gardens of Valloires Abbey and the colorful villas of Mers-les-Bains, this episode reveals the richness of the Picardy coastline. Amid marshes, dunes and vast stretches of wilderness, the bay is also home to remarkable wildlife, best discovered alongside the enthusiasts who strive to preserve its beauty.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Pyrénées-Orientales
programme.desc: Between sea and mountains, the Pyrénées-Orientales offer a unique setting. From Collioure, a coastal gem, to the legendary Canigou, and through the fortified towns of Villefranche-de-Conflent and Prats-de-Mollo, this journey explores a region steeped in Catalan history and traditions, and inhabited by people proud of their identity.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The wine route
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards. Our trip starts with a bit of tourism. We will cross the Drôme with Tain l'Hermitage and its Baume de Venise, but also the Bordeaux region where the different domains compete to attract this new clientele. Then we head for Épernay, capital of the Champagne region, where the reputation of its sparkling wine is well established.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The mushroom route
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a mushroom tour. There is nothing better to occupy your weekends than a walk in the forest in search of edible mushrooms. Some species, such as the cep or the chanterelle, can be preserved very well in the freezer or, for the more patient, in jars. We will also meet two chefs who are passionate about mushrooms and have become specialists in the subject: Franck Quinton and Régis Marcon.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Red mullet
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo cooks a Mediterranean fish, red mullet. On the menu: red mullet fillets with avocado purée and carrots with cumin, and red mullet mille-feuille with spring vegetables.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Sweet and gluten-free
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo welcomes Delphine Malachard, who is gluten intolerant. Together, they cook gluten-free recipes. On the menu: chocolate soufflé and vanilla and red fruit financiers.

programme.title: Health Explored - USA & Canada - Human Performance
programme.desc: In our season premiere we tackle the riveting question: How is it that some people have been able to reach the pinnacle of our human performance? Guided by Dr. David Behm, an expert in sports physiology, we venture into the lab to uncover the fascinating intersection of science and athletic performance. Then we take this theoretical knowledge into the real world, visiting a high-performance training facility where professional NHL athletes are honing their skills.

programme.title: Health Explored - New Zealand - The Blue Mind Part
programme.desc: In this episode set in scenic New Zealand, we explore the deep-rooted question: Does being near or in water actually improve our health? Guided by Dr. Wallace J. Nichols, author of "The Blue Mind," we delve into the scientific and emotional benefits of water, exemplified by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection to aquatic environments.

programme.title: Health Explored - New Zealand - The Blue Mind Part
programme.desc: We're still in New Zealand, where we look at the scientific and emotional benefits of water, illustrated by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection with aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we discover how New Zealand's abundant waters are more than just a natural spectacle; they're a source of holistic health and well-being.

programme.title: Health Explored -ndia - The Search for Mindfulness Part
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos.

programme.title: Health Explored - India - The Search for Mindfulness Part
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos.

programme.title: Health Explored - Buthan - The Pursuit of Happiness Part
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture.

programme.title: My Zen People - Louise (Oleron Island)
programme.desc: At only 20 years old, Louise is full of confidence and already achieved a personal dream of hers to share her passion for nutritious and locally-sourced ingredients on the island of Oleron, France. Repurposing a camping car, she set up a brunch and tea-time spot where the guests can hand-pick their ingredients in the adjacent organic fields.

Use this sequence to detoxify, build confidence and restore a sense of balance and wellbeing to take off the mat and into the rest of your day.

The exercises target both the lower and upper body while including movements that make for an effective cardio workout. Namaste Yoga - Reflect and Connect: Open Your Shoulders, Hips and Hamstrings
programme.desc: Are you ready to fly? Reflect and Connect will engage your whole body with a series of poses that first calm and center, and then awaken and inspire. Build energy and a sense of security before channeling your curiosity and testing your limits.

programme.title: Deco Masters - Week 10 - Day 04
programme.desc: It's Grégory's turn to prove that he's our Deco Master. The 37-year-old children's entertainer from Etterbeek has a colorful personality. At least, that's what his friends say. And in the four corners of his home are the objects Grégory thinks up, makes, sews or customizes to his heart's content.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The taste of bread
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - A la carte grills
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Lille country
programme.desc: Head north to discover a French city that cannot be ignored: Lille. The city has an exceptional architectural heritage, a merchant town since the Middle Ages, a citadel under Louis XIV, an industrial town in the 19th century... it expanded over the centuries.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The Country of Le Mans
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Truffle flavors
programme.desc: It is a mushroom that we are going to focus on today. A mushroom, or a black diamond, some would say: the truffle. And along the way, we will twist the neck of some clichés. Truffle hunting with dogs, with a sow but also flies... markets and of course cooking to discover or rediscover this mysterious mushroom, in all its aspects, in a salty but also sweet version... Richerenches, Carpentras, Saint Avère, Toulouse, Aix en Provence… the south of France will honor this black diamond!

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Fajitas
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Mexico with fajitas! A typical Tex-Mex dish. Together, we'll prepare tortillas (corn cakes). Next up, fajitas with chicken, peppers and spices.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - All vegetarian
programme.desc: Luana cooks with the interpreter of the flagship title of Frozen: Anaïs Delva. Together, they will prepare two 100% vegetarian recipes, a philosophy adopted by the singer. On the menu: grilled zucchini fettucini, white beans with pesto and a vegetarian burger. Proof that it's possible to enjoy vegetarian dishes without going hungry!

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Corrèze
programme.desc: A land of character, Corrèze is full of hidden treasures. From Collonges-la-Rouge, a flamboyant red sandstone town, to the Cistercian abbey of Aubazine, and through Beaulieu-sur-Dordogne and its medieval heritage, each place bears witness to a rich past. But beyond its monuments, this region is also seductive for its untouched nature and its passionate inhabitants, guardians of an age-old legacy.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Le Quercy
programme.desc: The Quercy region reveals architectural gems and enchanting landscapes. Rocamadour, a town clinging to its cliffs, Saint-Cirq-Lapopie, a picture-postcard village, and Castelnau-Bretenoux, a fairy-tale fortress, illustrate the richness of a land where tradition and history come together in perfect harmony.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Haut-Rhin
programme.desc: The Haut-Rhin is the epitome of Alsatian charm. Riquewihr and its grands crus, Eguisheim and its half-timbered houses, Colmar and its Little Venice reveal a region where architecture, gastronomy and vineyards come together to offer an unforgettable journey.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Fish on the menu
programme.desc: Julie takes us to the southern Brittany and more precisely the maritime district of Guilvinec to follow the fish route from the nets to your plate. Le Guilvinec may be the first French artisanal fishing port, but all the seashores of France have good seasonal products. Julie drives up to the south to discover several farmed fish in an aquaculture farm in the Mediterranean, while cooking sea bass in Noirmoutier, monkfish in the north and even cod in the huge market at Rungis.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Game season
programme.desc: We headed to the Loir-et-Cher for a hunt supervised by the ONCFS teams. Let's go to the Vosges to cook a tasty deer jig with Mauricette. Let's meet Pierre in the Côte d'Or where he makes hunting horns, an essential tool for hunting. Julie will also meet two hunters from Gironde for a very original afternoon of hunting by the barrel before joining Joël in Aquitaine for another game bird recipe. We will then talk with Laurent about the job of dog trainer.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Lentils
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo cooks the queen of vegetable proteins: lentils. Healthy, easily digestible and delicious, it replaces meat and fish. We're going to prepare spiced coral lentil patties, with a yoghurt and mint sauce. Next up, a classic French dish: green lentil salad with Morteau sausage.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Pies
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo welcomes her friend Séverine Ferrer, host and actress, to prepare pies. On the menu: gâteau patate (a Reunionese speciality with sweet potato) and a "Luarraine" tart, featuring all Luana's favorite ingredients (parmesan, pancetta...).

programme.title: Who will be the next great baker? - 1
programme.desc: This year, the jury and candidates meet at the Musée des Arts Forains for the third edition of the culinary competition, reserved for young pastry professionals. Christophe Michalak, Christophe Adam, Philippe Urraca and Pierre Marcolini will judge the work done during the weekly tests, in an attempt to find the rare pearl among Tristan, Matthieu, Nina, Cédric, Morgane, Gaëlle, Nathan and Gregory, eight talented candidates with a passion for their craft.

programme.desc: Balanced Being is a powerful, flowing sequence that creates presence and strength. Use this practice to root down, then rise up with confidence and a centered, balanced energy. A study of complimentary opposites, this practice will challenge you to find the balance within the opposition.

programme.title: Home training - lower body training 2
programme.desc: This episode of "Home Training" offers a session dedicated to lower body strengthening, specially designed by Guillaume. Participants are guided through a careful warm-up, essential to prepare the joints and avoid injury. The session focuses on the legs and glutes with varied and progressive exercises that also boost the cardio. Guillaume and Sabrina encourage maintaining an upright posture for effective and safe training.

programme.title: Pilates - Stay in shape with our pilates courses !
Namaste Yoga - Balance and Bend: Balance and Connect
programme.desc: Stand tall and find your truest state of focus and center with this balancing flow. Use the breath to align your posture and learn to experience your practice, rather than thinking it through. Asanas, the physical yoga poses, then become a practice of feeling more than a mental exercise.

programme.title: Deco Masters - Week 10 - Day 05
programme.desc: The four sites are now finished. Anthony, Vanessa, Samia and Grégory will hear their opponents' criticisms. The owners will also return home to find their rooms completely redecorated. What will they think of their new interior? How will they rate it? Who will be Valérie Damidot's favorite, and who will win the title of Deco Master?

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Sweets on the menu
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The flavors of flowers
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The Bordeaux country
programme.desc: Julie meets us in Bordeaux after having surveyed the Blaye region, visited the Basin twice and travelled through the Libourne region twice, it was necessary to stop in the capital of Bordeaux one day! What better time than September to discover the pearl of Aquitaine, more often called the "City of Wine"? Julie invites the inhabitants to discover the traditions but also the more recent projects of this city full of history and gastronomy.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The wine route
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards. Our trip starts with a bit of tourism. We will cross the Drôme with Tain l'Hermitage and its Baume de Venise, but also the Bordeaux region where the different domains compete to attract this new clientele. Then we head for Épernay, capital of the Champagne region, where the reputation of its sparkling wine is well established.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Lamb flavors
programme.desc: Tender and tasty, lamb plays a key role in festive cuisine but also in everyday cuisine. Julie sets off on the French roads to discover the different breeds existing across the country. It must be said that France has one of the most varied productions in the world. There are more than forty breeds listed in 5 categories. But more than the breed, it is the way in which they are fed that interests connoisseurs. Julie introduces us to producers and cooks of this refined dish!

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Red mullet
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo cooks a Mediterranean fish, red mullet. On the menu: red mullet fillets with avocado purée and carrots with cumin, and red mullet mille-feuille with spring vegetables.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Sweet and gluten-free
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo welcomes Delphine Malachard, who is gluten intolerant. Together, they cook gluten-free recipes. On the menu: chocolate soufflé and vanilla and red fruit financiers.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Charente Maritime
programme.desc: Charente-Maritime is a 500-kilometer coastline that conceals an unsuspected heritage. From La Rochelle and its fortified port to the Ile de Ré and its salt marshes, to Talmont-sur-Gironde, a medieval village perched on the estuary, this region reveals itself through the tides and encounters. An immersion between maritime traditions and historical relics.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Pays D'Auge-Calvados
programme.desc: The Pays d'Auge is the beating heart of Normandy. Honfleur with its picturesque port, the Basilica of Lisieux, a major pilgrimage site, and the Haras du Pin, the cradle of horse breeding, illustrate the diversity of this land of traditions, where craftsmanship and gastronomy reign supreme.

programme.title: 100 Places to See - Cornouaille
programme.desc: At the western tip of Finistère, Cornouaille embodies the very soul of Brittany. Concarneau and its centuries-old ramparts, Locronan and its cobbled streets, Le Guilvinec and its bustling fleet of trawlers reveal a Brittany that is both historic and vibrant. Between land and sea, this is a land shaped by sailors and legends.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The flavors of olive oil
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive. On the way, we will stop at the Sourdon family's house to cook sea bream accompanied by an olive fricot. We will then go to Aix en Provence to prepare a strange dessert: the Fernand-style oil pump.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Seashells on the menu
programme.desc: We will start this journey near La Rochelle to learn a little more about the breeding of the famous bouchot mussels but also a very particular technique to cook them. We will then go on a tour of France's best oysters: towards Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier and finally Oléron to learn about the different breeding methods and to find out more about all the species in France.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - West Indian cuisine
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo welcomes her friend Suzie Palatin to prepare West Indian cuisine. On the menu: chicken colombo, with coconut blancmange for dessert.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Pumpkin
programme.desc: In this episode, pumpkin takes center stage. Luana Belmondo cooks a spiced pumpkin velouté with parmesan shortbread. Next, she prepares pumpkin gnocchi with a creamy cheese sauce.

programme.title: Earth from above - Everything is living and everything is linked - Part 1
programme.desc: Through the most magnificent images and astonishing human stories, Man is at the heart of the biodiversity that he must respect and preserve. We find ourselves in Kenya, where the biodiversity is particularly rich, in the Massaï Mara reserve. Then, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the worrying disappearance of hippos from Lake Edward has unexpected consequences for the survival of fishermen.

programme.title: Earth from above - Everything is living and everything is linked - Part 2
programme.desc: Through the most magnificent images and amazing human stories, Man is at the heart of the biodiversity that he must respect and preserve. We go to China in the province of Yunan, where a plant with exceptional virtues against malaria has been discovered. Then we travel to Africa, where man's intervention in the ecosystem of Lake Victoria has triggered a considerable imbalance. We will also explore to Greenland to meet the polar bears, the first victims of the melting ice.

programme.title: Earth from above - Defending water is defending life - Part 1
programme.desc: He takes us to Petra in Jordan. We discover how the Nabataeans became specialists in collecting rainwater, which they managed meticulously. Then, we find ourselves in Las Vegas, on the verge of a shortage, and in Amman, Jordan, to discover the daily difficulties linked to the shortage and rationing of water. In Israel, the Dead Sea is disappearing. Due to intensive agriculture, the Jordan River and other rivers no longer supply it with enough water.

programme.desc: In this episode we remind viewers just how much you can find when exploring your own backyard by road tripping the California Coast to Santa Barbara! Swapping TV time to chats around the campfire and an exciting encounter with sea lions.

programme.desc: If the Atlantis Bahamas isn’t on your family's bucket list - it should be! We’ll show you why as each family member ticks off their dream adventure that also gives back. Proving this big resort has an even bigger heart.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints - Ranch Life - Texas
programme.desc: Sometimes exploring the road less traveled gives you the biggest adventure. In this episode, we escape the city buzz and opt for a quieter life on a Texas dude ranch. Taking time to appreciate the beauty in history, animals and quality time as a family.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Fish on the menu
programme.desc: Julie takes us to the southern Brittany and more precisely the maritime district of Guilvinec to follow the fish route from the nets to your plate. Julie drives up to the south to discover several farmed fish in an aquaculture farm in the Mediterranean, while cooking sea bass in Noirmoutier, monkfish in the north and even cod in the huge market at Rungis.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Citrus flavors
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The taste of bread

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Spicy kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a tour of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. In the kitchen, they bear witness to our relationship with others, reflecting our vision of the world. Julie's journey will introduce us to the famous black pepper, thanks to Erwann de Kerros, an insatiable pepper seeker. Aromatic plants will also be in the spotlight, as we pick them with Edouard Loubet in the Luberon...

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Shellfish on the menu
programme.desc: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - The mushroom route
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a mushroom tour. There is nothing better to occupy your weekends than a walk in the forest in search of edible mushrooms. Some species, such as the cep or the chanterelle, can be preserved very well in the freezer or, for the more patient, in jars. We will also meet two chefs who are passionate about mushrooms and have become specialists in the subject: Franck Quinton and Régis Marcon.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Poultry on the menu
programme.desc: Julie heads for Burgundy to discover ancient breeds of poultry reintroduced to France thanks to the work of breeder Fred Ménager. We'll then move on to Auvergne to discover how the famous Label Rouge is awarded and the role of certifying bodies ... because it's important to know what ends up on our plates. Julie also travels to the Drôme to cook guinea fowl, before heading to the Périgord to prepare a turkey stew.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - winter vegetables
programme.desc: Summer is the season when vegetables abound in the garden, but it would be a shame not to savor those that the cooler seasons have to offer: soups, pies, stews or gratins highlight seasonal vegetables, perfect for a nice warm up. To begin this new journey, Julie will cook salsify. This little tour of France will also allow us to meet gardening goldsmiths who sculpt winter vegetables and fruits.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Pizza party
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo invites her friend Eleonora Galasso for a pizza party! First, they'll make homemade dough. Next, they'll cook a capriciosa with anchovies, capers and ham, and a pizza fritta with oregano and tomato sauce.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen - Chickpeas
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo cooks chickpeas. As they originate from the Middle East, she decides to prepare Lebanese recipes. On the menu: fallafel with chickpeas, kumquat, spices and cinnamon, and chard with chickpeas, parsley, mint and bulgur.

programme.title: Health Investigation - Bipolar Disorder: From One Extreme to the Other
programme.desc: Are We All Bipolar? We all experience mood swings in life. But when emotions become too intense, leading to uncontrollable reactions and all kinds of extreme behavior, we’re talking about bipolar disorder—a condition that affects more than one million people in France. In recent years, this disorder has regularly been in the media spotlight. Benoît Poelvoorde, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Jim Carrey… Many are said to suffer from bipolar disorder and have spoken openly about it.

programme.title: The Superpowers of the Bear
programme.desc: In the misty Swedish Taiga, a team of doctors is searching for hibernating brown bears. Their want to analyze their blood as well as samples of their tissues, in order to understand how these mammals can survive long months of inactivity. Do their genes really hold the secrets to treat humans in the future?

programme.title: Massages
programme.desc: Massage studio will show you the best massage techniques in places which will make you dream. Let us take care of you! Lay down, relax and forget all your problems.

programme.title: Yoga
programme.desc: Practice Yoga from the comfort of your home with our experienced teatchers.

programme.title: Spiritual Sports
programme.desc: Nurture the body AND the mind with Spiritual Sports

DogMan
programme.desc: Jako dítě byl Douglas týrán násilnickým otcem, který ho hodil do kotce psům. No psy mu neublíží, místo útoku se stanou jeho ochránci a jedinou rodinou. Mučivé dětství se odrazí na chlapcově složité psychice a poznačilo celý jeho další život. Jak dospěje, unikne z brutálního domácího prostŕedí, ale zůstává emocionálně i fyzicky zjizvený. Žije na okraji společnosti. Jehu jedinou útěchou jsou psy, které vychovává a cvičí s neskutečnou oddaností. V sousedství ho znají jako “Psího muže”.

programme.title: Černobyl
programme.desc: Ruský velkofilm o následcích výbuchu v černobylské jaderné elektrárně, kdy stovky lidí obětovali své životy, aby uklidili místo katastrofy a úspěšně zabránili ještě větší katastrofě, která by mohla proměnit velkou část evropského kontinentu v neobyvatelnou zónu. Nečekaným hrdinou filmu je Alexej, hasič v elektrárně. Na nebezpečné misi ho doprovází inženýr Valerij a vojenský potápěč Boris. Jejich úlohou je vypustit vodu z nádrže pod hořícím reaktorem.

programme.title: Skutečné vraždy: Co zaseješ, to sklidíš
programme.desc: Stará přítelkyně Aurory Teagardenové, Poppy Wilsonová, se stala internetovou senzací. Vrátila se do Lawrencetonu, aby si otevřela nový podnik s vyšíváním. Ne všichni se ale z Poppyina úspěchu radují. Když ji Aurora najde doma mrtvou, zmobilizuje členy klubu skutečných vražd a začnou případ rozebírat. Výsledkem jsou čtyři podezřelí a čtyři motivy. Ro se musí vydat po stopách znepokojivé pravdy. Americko - kanadský kriminální film . C. L. Haggquist. E. Harvie

programme.title: Dívka jménem Willow
programme.desc: Willow zdědí les, dům a umění čarovat po pratetě Alwine. Musí najít další tři dívky s magickými dary, aby les zachránila. Naštěstí má po svém boku lišáka Rufuse. Willow zdědila domek v lese, který jí odkázala prateta Alwine. Prastarý les i domek odkrývají svá tajemství, protože k dědictví patří i kouzla a čarodéjná moc, ze které má Willow husí kůži po těle. Má to všechno přijmout?

programme.title: Julie, co by bylo kdyby…
programme.desc: Jedna Julie a mnoho jejich podob v cyklu života. Úspěšná klaviristka Julie oslavuje v Paříži 2052 osmdesátiny a vzpomíná na svůj život. Byl naplněný, šťastný a krásný. Ale co by bylo, kdyby se všechno stalo jinak, kdyby se její osud ubíral jiným směrem? Víme, že v životě hrají velkou roli náhody. Můžou ale zásadně zasáhnout, nebo máme svoji cestu předem nalinkovanou? Jaká to byla náhoda, která zasáhla v den jejich sedmnáctých narozenin?

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Náš svět
programme.desc: Dokument poodhalí osobní život Justina Biebera a zákulisí jeho přípravy na silvestrovský koncert 31. prosince 2020 na střeše hotelu Beverly Hilton. Koncertu se zúčastnilo 240 fanoušků a byl živě streamován po celém světě. Film obsahuje také autoportréty Biebera a jeho manželky Hailey. Americký dokumentární film . Účinkují: J. Bieber, H. Bieber, S. Braun, N. DeMoura, M.Drew, J. Erasme a další

programme.title: Záhady na ostrově: Otrávená v ráji
programme.desc: Když je na pláži nalezena mrtvá místní servírka a na Zeeině bankovním účtu se objeví záhadný vklad, ukáže se, že Martha's Vineyard je vším, jen ne tím jednoduchým, malebným místem, po kterém Jeff Jackson toužil. Jeffova pověst „neoficiálního“ řešitele nejnebezpečnějších zločinů na ostrově roste. Když se mladá servírka Katie ocitne v nesprávných situacích s nesprávnými lidmi, objeví se a požádá ho o pomoc. Jeff na ni naléhá, aby šla rovnou na policii, ale ona se příliš bojí, aby to udělala.

programme.title: Akademie hvězd
programme.desc: Film o teenagerech, kteří se účastňují letního tábora, kde soutěží o nejlepšího umělce v specializovaném uměleckém programu zaměřeném na tanec, hip-hop a psaní písní. Kelly tam má taky strávit část léta Prestižní múzický program Next Level. vede svérázný režisér Bob a zkušená umělkyně Jasmine Joel, která v programu Next Level začínala. S většinou dalších účastnic si ale Kelly nerozumí, spřátelí se jen s malou Josie a klukem z basketbalového tábora, Conorem.

programme.title: Super-Blb
programme.desc: Cédric Dugimont bojuje s osudem neúspěšného herce, který se snaží prosadit. Když mu je konečně. jednoho dne nabídnuta hlavní role superhrdinu ve filmu s názvem Badman, má pocit, že všechno je možné. Po měsících intenzivního tréninku Cédric začíná natáčet s proslulým hercem Alainem Belmontem, který hraje Badmanova úhlavního nepřítele Klauna. Po prvním dni natáčení dostane Cédric zprávu, že jeho otec, policejní šéf Michel, náhle zkolaboval.

programme.title: Skutečné vraždy: Záhadné zmizení
programme.desc: Aurora má bratrance Phlilipa, o kterého pečuje jako starší sestra. Pozve ho na večeři i s jeho spolubydlícím Joshem a Joshovou přítelkyní Tammy.Večeŕi zmeškají a Ro se vydá Philipa hledat. Namísto něj najde mrtvou Tammy v uličce za kadeŕnickým salonem. Josh a Philip zmizeli. Vyšetřování vede detektiv Arthur Smith, který byl kdysi sám členem Klubu Skutečných vražd.

programme.title: Druhá šance
programme.desc: Rozvedená matka se snaží uzavřít mír se svou narušenou rodinou, když najde druhou šanci na lásku. Abigail (Dianna Agron) je rozvedená matka dvou dětí. Její rodiče Barbara (Candice Bergen) a Eugene (Dustin Hoffman) už potřebují podle specialistu pečovatele. Eugene je umístěn do hospice, nakolik mu zbývá jen pár měsíců života. To Barbaru zničí. Abigail navštíví svého odcizeného bratra Nathana (Simon Helberg), ten jde za otcem, s matkou však nechce mluvit.

programme.title: Film roku
programme.desc: Bohatý podnikatel, který touží po slávě a společenské prestíži, chce natočit průlomový film, co dostane celý svět do kolen. Aby tohoto cíle dosáhl, najme si ty nejlepší z nejlepších. Hvězdný tým tvoří slavná, excentrická režisérka Lola Cuevas (Penelope Cruz) a dva proslulí herci, kteří se pyšní nejen obrovským talentem, ale ještě větším egem. Jsou to hollywoodské hvězdy Félix Rivero (Antonio Banderas) a stárnoucí divadelní charakterový herec Iván Torres (Oscar Martinez).

programme.title: Ukolébavka
programme.desc: Co můžete říct, když nevyřčeného zůstalo mnoho? Film zkoumá otázky práva na smrt těžce nemocného člověka, který se rozhodl přestat brát léky a odpojit přístroje na podporu života. Jak jeho rozhodnutí ovlivní vztahy rodinných příslušníků s ním a mezi sebou navzájem? Mladý muž, který už dlouho neudržuje kontakt se svou rodinou dostane zprávu, aby přišel navštívit svého nevyléčitelně chorého otce, kterému zbývá jen 48 hodin života. Jonathan (Garrett Hedlund) ani netuší, co ho čeká.

programme.title: Ukolébavka
programme.desc: Co můžete říct, když nevyřčeného zůstalo mnoho? Film zkoumá otázky práva na smrt těžce nemocného člověka, který se rozhodl přestat brát léky a odpojit přístroje na podporu života. Jak jeho rozhodnutí ovlivní vztahy rodinných příslušníků s ním a mezi sebou navzájem? Mladý muž, který už dlouho neudržuje kontakt se svou rodinou dostane zprávu, aby přišel navštívit svého nevyléčitelně chorého otce, kterému zbývá jen 48 hodin života. Jonathan (Garrett Hedlund) ani netuší, co ho čeká.

programme.title: To nejsi Ty
programme.desc: Jedna minuta může změnit všechno. Zapomeňte na to, kým jste byli a objevte, kým máte být. Filmové drama natočené podle uznávaného románu americké spisovatelky Michelle Wildgenové. Úspěšné klavírní virtuózce Kate (Hilary Swanková) právě diagnostikovali nevyléčitelnou degenerativní nemoc. Její manžel Evan (Josh Duhamel) je pracovně vytížený, proto si najmou vysokoškolačku Bec (Emmy Rossumová) jako ošetřovatelku.

programme.title: Dům na mušce
programme.desc: Simon a Adélaide jsou unaveni městským životem a rozhodnou se koupit dům na venkově. Zanechají svoje bydlení v Paříži a přestěhují se i se svými dvěma dětmi do tiché vesničky Saint-Hubert-des-Bois. Dům je prostranný, má velkou zahradu sousedící s lesem. Zdá se, že našli klid a pohodu . Spřátelí se se svými sousedy, Bernardem a Michelem, no s příchodem podzimu zjistí, že oba sousedi jsou srdcem i duší nimrodi. Jejich zahrada a přilehlé lesy se stávají loveckým revírem.

programme.title: Upír junior
programme.desc: Příběh Rudolpha, třináctiletého upíra, jehož klan ohrožuje notoricky známý lovec upírů. Potkává Tonyho, smrtelníka stejného věku, kterého fascinují staré hrady, hřbitovy a - upíři. Tony pomáhá Rudolphovi v akční a humorné bitvě proti jejich protivníkům. Společně zachraňují Rudolphovu rodinu a stávají se přáteli. Dánsko - německo - holandský animovaný film

programme.title: Panda a já
programme.desc: Poté, co je chlapec kvůli špatným známkám poslán k babičce, najde tam mládě pandy a začne léto plné přátelství a dobrodružství.Tianovi je dvanáct let, když je kvůli špatným školním výsledkům poslán k babičce. Daleko od města, v tajemných čínských horách, se tajně spřátelí s pandou, které dá jméno Moon. To znamená začátek neuvěřitelného dobrodružství, které změní jeho život i život jeho rodiny. Francouzsko - belgicko - americký rodinný film

programme.title: Ztracený poklad delfíní zátoky
programme.desc: Patnáctiletá Quinn Perkinsová je nadšená, že tráví léto jako stážistka se svou nejlepší kamarádkou Danielou a otcem mořského biologa Charlieho. Neviděli se od té doby, co Charlie zdědil výzkumné centrum v Dolphin Cove v Austrálii. Když Quinn dorazí, s překvapením zjistí, že se k nim přidávají další stážisté - Danielina nová kamarádka Jennifer a rádoby dobrodruh Teddy.

programme.title: Sestry v sedle
programme.desc: Pět rádových sester pečuje o seniory umístěné v hospicu. Jelikož toto zařízení je na rozpadnutí a chátrá dál bez potřebných oprav, rozhodnou se, že pomohou s renovací budovy. U starosty města se ale dozví, že nemá na renovaci hospice žádné finanční prostředky. Důvodem jsou velké cyklistické závody, do kterých muselo město investovat a na nic jiného nezbylo. Mnišky vzplanou spravedlivým hněvem, ale nic naplat. Kde vzít peníze?

programme.title: Zastavte tu svatbu!
programme.desc: Dva mladí lidé, kteří hodlají překazit svatbu tety jednoho a otce druhého, se navzdory vzájemnnému odporu do sebe zamilují. Anna se po bouřlivé romanci rozhodne už jen pro kariéru. Zanedlouho se dozví, že její teta Belle se hodlá vdát za několikanásobně rozvedeného herce Seana. Je odhodlaná svatbu překazit.K jejímu úsilí se připojí Seanův syn, pohledný chirurg Clay. I když jsou si ti dva navzájem odporní, společný cíl je sjednocuje. Belle a Sean prchají do Las Vegas, aby unikli a stihli svatbu.

programme.title: Addamsova rodina 2
programme.desc: Morticiu a Gomeze nacházíme v zoufalém stavu z toho, že jejich děti dospívají, začínají vynechávat rodinné večeře a jsou zcela pohlceni jinými aktivitami, než společným časem s rodinou. Rozhodnou se tedy znova upevnit rodinná pouta. Nacpou Wednesday, Pugsleyho, strýčka Festera a ostatní příslušníky rodiny do svého strašidelného karavanu a vydají se na poslední ponurou rodinnou dovolenou.

programme.title: Nerozlučná dvojka
programme.desc: Přátelství je největší dobrodružství . Příběh Dona, uprchlé loutky, která má nekonečnou fantazii a opuštěného plyšového zvířátka DJ Doggy Doga, které potřebuje kamaráda. Jejich cesty se setkají v Central Parku a i když jsou odlišní, spojí je přátelství. Už jim nic nebrání vydat se společně za dobrodružstvím. Francouzsko - španělsko - belgický animovaný film

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Náš svět
programme.desc: Dokument poodhalí osobní život Justina Biebera a zákulisí jeho přípravy na silvestrovský koncert 31. prosince 2020 na střeše hotelu Beverly Hilton. Koncertu se zúčastnilo 240 fanoušků a byl živě streamován po celém světě. Film obsahuje také autoportréty Biebera a jeho manželky Hailey. Americký dokumentární film . Účinkují: J. Bieber, H. Bieber, S. Braun, N. DeMoura, M.Drew, J. Erasme a další

programme.title: Skutečné vraždy: Hra na kočku a myš
programme.desc: Do Klubu skutečných vražd přivádí Aurora svého bratrance, vysokoškolského studenta Phillipa Pifera a relativně nového přítele Nicka Millera, profesora psychologie na místní vysoké škole. Den před schůzkou Klubu zmizí Roiny diskusní materiály. Vandal zanechal na jedné z Roiných fotografií z místa činu vizitku s načmáraným knižním citátem. Něco podobného se následně stane v realitní kanceláři Roiny matky Aidy a znovu je tam zanechán citát.

programme.title: Těhotná s.r.o
programme.desc: Film vypráví o svobodné porodní asistentce Merel (Lieke van Lexmond), která nedokáže najít dokonalého partnera. Protože její biologické hodiny tikají, nakonec se rozhodne otěhotnět prostřednictvím dárce spermatu. Ale to je jenom začátek. Jako kdyby její těhotenství bylo nakazlivé, najednou otěhotní i mladá partnerka Merelina šedesátiletého otce Pieta. Pak je tady neteř Eva - taky v očekávání. A starší sestra Annet…Rodina se pěkně rozšiřuje! Nizozemský romantický film

programme.title: Vzpomeň si
programme.desc: Za pomoci kamaráda, s kterým přežil Osvětim a jeho dopisu hledá starý muž s demencí člověka, odpovědného za smrt jeho rodiny v táboře smrti, kde měl umřít i on sám. Příběh devadesátiletého Zeva Guttmana (Christopher Plummer), sužovaného selhávající pamětí, který tráví poslední roky života v poklidném pečovatelském domě. Týden po smrti milované ženy Ruth náhle obdrží šokující dopis od blízkého přítele Maxe (Martin Landau) a s ním balík peněz.

programme.title: Maria
programme.desc: Bouřlivý, krásný a tragický příběh života největší operní pěvkyně světa. Maria Callas, nejikoničtější, legendární sopranistka a jedinečná světová operní pěvkyně. Tato okouzlující, mimořádná operní diva, která svým hlasem okouzlovala a dojímala posluchače celého světa, prožívá poslední dny svého života v Paříži 70. let 20. století, kde se konfrontuje se svou identitou. V roce 1977 žije Maria Callas (Angelina Jolie) v pařížském bytě se svým komorníkem Ferrucciem a hospodyní Brunou.

programme.title: Aftersun
programme.desc: V tureckém prázdninovém letovisku si jedenáctiletá Sophie užívá vzácný čas společně se svým milujícím a idealistickým otcem Calumem (Paul Mescal). Jak se do jejího zorného pole vkrádá svět dospívání, vidí, jak se Calum potýká s tíhou života mimo otcovství. I když táta nezkazí žádnou zábavu, čelí melancholii a téžké depresi. O dvacet let později se Sophiiny něžné vzpomínky na jejich poslední prázdniny stanou silným a srdceryvným portrétem jejich vztahu.

programme.title: Poslední hranice
programme.desc: Film vypráví příběh podolských kadetů a jejich hrdinského boje u Moskvy v říjnu 1941. Kadeti z podolských vojenských škol byli vysláni na Iljinskou obrannou linii a bojovali po boku jednotek sovětské 43. armády, aby zadrželi Němce, dokud nedorazí posily. Mladí muži, vlastně ještě děti, položili své životy v bitvě trvající téměř dva týdny, aby znemožnili postup německých jednotek do Moskvy. Kolem 3500 kadetů bojovaloi proti daleko větší a vyzbrojenější přesile.

programme.title: Záhady na ostrově: Otrávená v ráji
programme.desc: Když je na pláži nalezena mrtvá místní servírka a na Zeeině bankovním účtu se objeví záhadný vklad, ukáže se, že Martha's Vineyard je vším, jen ne tím jednoduchým, malebným místem, po kterém Jeff Jackson toužil. Jeff na ni naléhá, aby šla rovnou na policii, ale ona se příliš bojí, aby to udělala.
